method: SGD-trained synthetic CNN head (float32) → shared export-quantize to 12 mantissa bits (simulates ONNX/edge deploy). Stego = inert high-entropy bits written into those freed low mantissa planes (contiguous or scattered). Clean sibling stops at export-quantize. This matches EvilModel-style LSB stego under a declared quantization contract — not the prior circular 'wipe then detect' trick on raw float32.
